purpose: Formal validation protocol for the node-influence upgrade of paper1. Frozen BEFORE any formal sampling. Pilot records are kept separate and never merged into formal intervals.

model.name: independent-node binary predictions
model.A_operator: X_A = sum_e (a_e - p_e) H_e, H_e = 1_e 1_e^T / r_e
model.B_operator: X_B = sum_e (b_e - p_e) H_e, b_e ~ Bern(p_e) independent edges
model.spectral_norm: max(|lambda_min|, |lambda_max|) via eigsh both ends, tol 1e-6
model.no_posthoc: no edge deletion or label re-picking on native graphs

family_A_amplification.description: non-star overlapping block: edges {u_i, w_j, leaf_ij}, w_j drawn from a per-block pool of size d/kappa (bounded co-occurrence kappa), fresh leaves; blocks node-disjoint
family_A_amplification.predicted: phi_{u_i,e} = 0.95+0.95-1 = 0.90 aligned; Phi_i = 0.9 d/3; certification region d >= ~180 (T4); amplification Theta(d) vs O(sqrt(d log n)); t=60 gives no-hub-event prob (1-eps)^t = 0.046, so sep allowance ~0.906

family_B_competition.description: single hub u with d edges {u, w_j, leaf_j}, all co-members FRESH (no shared pair), leaf bias gamma swept from aligned to competing
family_B_competition.predicted: phi_u = 0.95 + gamma - 1 = gamma - 0.05; amplification collapses to exact second-order cancellation Var_A(x)=Var_B(x) (all directions) at gamma=0.05; V1/V_B peaks at gamma=0.95

formal_grid.structure: family_A: 6 d-values x 256 draws; family_B: 6 gamma-values at d=200 x 256 draws; total 12 points x 256 independent node-prediction draws
formal_grid.native: Cora-CC and DBLP-CA binarized (majority vs rest); noise p in {0.05, 0.15}; 30 independent prediction draws per (graph, p); controlled-error model, not real-classifier-noise theorem

seeds.collision_check: all seeds disjoint from saved runs (31k/32k/33k/36k/41k/44k/49k/52k/60k/61k blocks and 42/20261008/20261009/99/777/31337)

statistics.resample_unit: one full prediction draw (nodes within a draw are not independent repeats)

formal_grid.failure_handling: eigsh non-convergence: rerun same instance once with tol 1e-4; still failing -> record as missing, never reseed
registered_hypotheses: H1 (family A): T4 certification nonempty for d >= 180 and empirical separation frequency >= 87% (allowance 1-(1-eps)^60 - eta - eta2 - delta = 0.876) throughout d >= 100
H2 (family A): mean betaA grows linearly in d (fitted slope on d in {150..300} within 25% of 0.9/3), betaB grows as sqrt(d)

H3 (family B): directional variance ratio varA/varB at the hub witness equals 1 within bootstrap CI at gamma=0.05 (exact equality predicted); centered norm ratio mean betaA/betaB within 15% of 1 at gamma=0.05 and >= 1.5 at gamma=0.95; separation frequency is NOT pre-registered at the endpoint (distributional asymmetry may remain; recorded, not tested)
H4 (native): influence profile on native graphs has hub-concentrated Phi (top-1 node share of V1 >= 50% for at least one p) or is reported as diffuse (boundary finding, both outcomes reported)

pilot.purpose: cost estimation and pipeline debugging only; records kept in results/pilot/, never merged into formal intervals

stop_rules: Per plan section 2: stop at first failed innovation gate or 120 h total; scientific blockers (counterexample, irreproducibility) halt submission push regardless
